amendments.reason: Delegate the code-surface fetch to the cases track's hardened fetcher: https only, no operator git configuration, hooks, submodules or filter drivers, GIT_* dropped, pin checked before checkout, and a checkout reused only when it holds exactly the pinned tree.
Update certifi from 2026.7.22 to 2026.10.19 for GHSA-6q48-6c7w-9gw2, matching Nexus-ShadowScan#290; both distribution hashes checked against PyPI.

Add the --keys scheme: canonical-v1 compares reported and truth keys by tools.shadowbench.keys.canonical, refuses a scheme that merges truth keys of a case, and records a non-default scheme as key_scheme; the default exact scheme leaves every committed run re-scoring byte for byte.
State a non-default key scheme and the sandbox a run recorded (backend, namespaces or image and runtime, resource limits); reports of manifests without either are unchanged.

Run in fresh UTS and cgroup namespaces with a fixed host name, refuse to set it in the runner's UTS namespace, lower resource limits before anything runs (no core dumps, 4 GiB files, 4096 open files and processes), leave an already-up loopback alone, and add a contained mode for the OCI backend that refuses to skip its mounts on the runner's root file system.

Probe every stage namespace before running, pass resource limits and the host name to the stage, add the --sandbox oci backend (digest-pinned image, read-only root, only the run directory writable, four capabilities for the stage, no-new-privileges, seccomp, memory/CPU/pids limits, optional gVisor), and record isolation and the install_tools.sh resolved/ record (tool_install) in the manifest.

Install PyPI tools from committed universal hash locks with --require-hashes --no-deps and uv pip check, build the Fleet wrapper against a committed go.mod and go.sum instead of go mod tidy, take an optional tool list, and record the resolved set (freeze, go version -m, locks, SHA256SUMS) under TOOL_ROOT/resolved/.
The run_one stage doubles accept the optional sandbox argument _stage now takes.
The as-if-root runner.main helper also stubs the new namespace probe, as it already stubs unshare and the isolation checks.
The installer test asserts hash-locked installs (--require-hashes --no-deps, no go mod tidy) instead of the old version-pinned header.

note: Append-only record of changes to migrated harness code and tests. Evidence is never amended; see tools/verify_migration.py.
